name: Pampers Rewards
whatYouGet: Free loyalty app: scan the code inside Pampers diaper or wipe packs to earn Pampers Cash (0 per 10 diaper scans), redeemable for discounts on Pampers at retailers.
costDetail: Free to download and join; page says no subscription or hidden fees. Rewards are discounts on Pampers purchases.
catches: Earning needs Pampers purchases. Pampers Cash expires 6 months after being added or if the account is inactive 6 months. App works on one device at a time. Page also promotes a 7-day free trial of a separate Baby Sleep app.
notes: Formerly called Pampers Club. Referral: invite up to 5 friends for $2 each for them and up to $10 for you.

name: Huggies Rewards
whatYouGet: Free rewards program and app where purchases of Huggies products earn points that can be redeemed for rewards such as gift cards.
catches: Points require buying Huggies products. Search snippets disagree on the sign-up bonus amount, so none is listed. Older Rewards+ (Fetch) earning ended per a Huggies page.
notes: huggies.com blocks automated fetching (Cloudflare 403); details come from huggies.com search results only.
